# Onez Codes

> Onez Codes is a software house that designs and ships web apps, custom software, iOS and Android products, and product UX — then stays on after launch.

## Services

- Web applications: product sites, dashboards, and customer portals
- Custom software: internal tools and platforms shaped around how a team works
- Product & UX: structure, interface, and copy with engineering
- Ongoing support: care, iteration, and delivery after launch

## Work

- Final Third Zone (live): https://www.finalthirdzone.com/ — bilingual football newsroom
- SayDiagram (live): https://saydiagram.com — Mermaid diagram platform
- Lumiere (coming soon) — tarot marketplace, iOS and web
- Stride (coming soon) — AI fitness coach, React Native and Laravel
